subject.title: fix(plugins): stream hash oversized files in safeHashFile

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the new bounded-memory, regular-file-only `safeHashFile` contract even though the documented partial-hash regression is not present in the visible baseline diff?
rationale: The code path is technically coherent, but the discrepancy changes the decision from correcting an established truncation bug to accepting a behavior and reliability-policy change.

options.title: Adopt the bounded-memory contract
options.body: Approve the descriptor-bound split path after the PR body is corrected to describe the actual unbounded-read/OOM and safety rationale.

options.title: Keep existing semantics
options.body: Decline the behavior change if plugin-index hashing must continue accepting all currently readable targets or if no demonstrated large-file risk warrants the added contract.
